about_short_description.short_description: Tiptap is the developer toolkit for building collaborative apps.

product.name: Tiptap Editor
product.description: A headless, framework-agnostic rich text editor based on ProseMirror for building custom content experiences.

product.name: Collaboration Features
product.description: Real-time collaborative document editing with offline-first support, enabling multiple users to edit simultaneously.

product.name: Content AI Integration
product.description: In-line content manipulation using custom large language models or OpenAI APIs within the editor.

product.name: Comments Functionality
product.description: Integration of document and in-line commenting features into applications for enhanced collaboration.

product.name: Document Management API
product.description: API-first tools for managing and manipulating documents on frontend and backend systems.

product.name: Tiptap Cloud and On-Premises Deployment
product.description: Options to deploy Tiptap services via cloud infrastructure or on-premises using Docker images.
